question_or_proposition: For the Whole Effluent Toxicity NOEC requirements for Daphnia pulex and Pimephales promelas in the Part I WET table, does the stated Once/Quarter frequency together with footnote (*9) independently establish the applicable WET monitoring frequency and conditions beginning on the permit effective date—or does determining applicable monitoring for Federal FY2025 require resolving the PART II Whole Effluent Toxicity testing requirements referenced in (*9), including the frequency reduction option?

PART II Whole Effluent Toxicity testing requirements (referenced in footnote *9 but outside local structural context)

notes: Footnote (*9) cross-references PART II for additional WET monitoring and reporting conditions and a frequency reduction option, creating ambiguity about whether the Part I table alone determines monitoring applicability (Purpose B) and the baseline for classifying missing WET results (Purpose C).
